chunks.heading: Growing Up
chunks.notes: The poem builds toward its close via a triadic anaphora ("Make it beautiful, make it memorable, make it a... CRESCENDO!!!"), lands repeated gnomic/aphoristic statements about death and life throughout ("Death is neither sad nor happy..."), processes grief for a father-figure through catalogued sensory textures (peanuts in Coke, baseball, dirt under his nails, raised beds), and frames all of this explicitly as a coming-of-age realization about mortality and the fading of ordinary habits into memory.
